intake.description: Within-workflow decision: watch the PR review loop or run a one-shot reviewer fix.

github_review_loop.description: Watch the PR and remediate review feedback until a terminal condition; reviewer-return outcomes are named transitions.

github_reviewer_fix.description: One-shot GitHub reviewer fix pass; reviewer-return outcomes are named transitions.

review_remediation_plan.description: Cerebrate re-plans remediation when review escalates to the planner.

implement_next_step.description: Explicit loop head: branch back to implement_step while steps remain, forward to validate when all steps complete.

implement_step.description: Overlord delegates the current remediation step to a static-allowed bioform, picked by intent.

checkpoint.description: Molt a checkpoint commit after the completed remediation step.

validate.description: Overlord runs validation and judges pass/fail before returning to the review loop.
